Subject: Re: P0: Lakeview experiencing high 5xx rate and 1.5–3s tail latency in us-east-1

Quick technical update (early):
- Observed increased retransmits and connection resets on the us-east-1 AZ1 egress cluster; per-host error logs show a noisy process causing sudden CPU pressure and request queueing.
- KV cache miss amplification on a subset of models is amplifying latency under these error rates (see last 30m histograms).

Immediate mitigation I recommend now:
1) Shift Lakeview traffic from us-east-1 to us-west-2 via policy override (geo-swap) for the next 60 minutes and enable continuous canary at 5% initially.
2) Enable aggressive prefix caching for predictable paths to reduce tokenization recompute for the next hour.
3) Drain affected AZ1 hosts and cordon the noisy hosts for investigation; collect heap/metrics.

I’ll run the runbook steps 2.1–2.6 and post logs to the shared Drive. If we see any regression after the geo-swap we’ll rollback to prior routing.

Runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinfra.com/runbooks/az-failover (see section "Immediate geo-swap")
PagerDuty incident: https://app.pagerduty.com/incidents/PLD123456

— Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer
